_: Editorial for glove-tour. Shared keys come from the family file.
_specs: Nothing about this product's construction is published. Unverifiable rows are marked, not guessed.
buyBody: A tour glove with the clover on the closure. It is a glove — it grips, it wears out, you buy another one. This one costs less than the pro-shop equivalent and has better branding on it.

four.v: Pick the hand it goes ON
Less than the ones in the pro shop

details.headline: The one thing in your bag with an expiry date
paras: Gloves are a consumable. They stretch, they go shiny in the palm, and the day you notice is about a month after they stopped helping.
Buy two. Everyone who plays regularly ends up doing this and nobody regrets it.

details.headline: The hand it goes on, not the hand you play with
paras: A right-handed golfer wears a glove on the LEFT hand. That trips people up constantly, so: pick Left if you play right-handed.
Stock is thin at the moment and most combinations are unavailable — the picker greys out anything that is not genuinely buyable rather than letting you find out at checkout.
